parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true`: `MockDiscogsEntityResolver.resolveArtist` in `Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsMarkupParserTests.swift` (package `Metadata`) and `MockDiscogsEntityResolver.resolveMaster` in `WXYC/iOS/Tests/WXYCTests/DiscogsFormatterTests.swift` (package `app:iOS`). Per the restraint rules, any cluster where even one record is test-scoped must be treated as a test-fixture and left alone; here both records are test-scoped, making the case unambiguous. The two methods are distinct resolver stubs (`resolveArtist` vs `resolveMaster`) serving different test suites in different packages, and their structural similarity (Jaccard 0.71) is incidental to their roles as isolated mock helpers. Merging or genericising them would couple unrelated test modules and risk obscuring the intent of each fixture.
